1. A manufacturing system comprising:
a robot arm comprising an end effector, wherein the robot arm is configured to transport objects within the manufacturing system; and
a controller operatively coupled to the robot arm, wherein the controller is to:
detect a presence of an object placed on the end effector of the robot arm;
apply vacuum pressure to a space between the object and the end effector via one or more vacuum grip pads of the end effector, wherein the vacuum pressure is applied to secure the object to the end effector;
obtain, by one or more pressure sensors of the robot arm, a vacuum pressure measurement indicating an amount of vacuum pressure between the object and the end effector;
determine whether the obtained vacuum pressure measurement satisfies a vacuum pressure criterion;
determine a transport speed setting for transporting the object using the robot arm based on whether the obtained vacuum pressure measurement satisfies the vacuum pressure criterion; and
causing the robot arm to move the object according to the transport speed setting.
2. The manufacturing system of claim 1, wherein determining the transport speed setting comprises:
responsive to determining that the obtained vacuum pressure measurement does not satisfy the vacuum pressure criterion, determining a first transport speed setting, wherein the first transport speed setting corresponds to a first transport speed that is slow enough such that the object is secured to the end effector based on a frictional force between the object and the end effector.
3. The manufacturing system of claim 2, wherein determining the transport speed setting comprises:
responsive to determining that the obtained vacuum pressure measurement satisfies the vacuum pressure criterion, determining a second transport speed setting, wherein the second transport speed setting corresponds to a second transport speed that is faster than the first transport speed.
4. The manufacturing system of claim 1, wherein determining the transport speed setting comprises:
responsive to determining that the obtained vacuum pressure measurement does not satisfy the vacuum pressure criterion, determining a default transport speed setting associated with the robot arm.
5. The manufacturing system of claim 1, wherein the controller is further to:
determine a first material type associated with the object; and
determine a transport speed based at least in part on the material type for the object.
6. The manufacturing system of claim 5, wherein the controller is further to:
determine a second material type associated with the one or more vacuum grip pads;
wherein the transport speed is determined based on the first material type and the second material type, and wherein the first material type comprises a silicon-based material type and the second material type comprises at least one of a polyaryletherketone-based material type, a polybenzimidazole-based material type, a polyimide-based material type, a polyethylene-based material type, or a perfluoroelastomer-based material type.
7. The manufacturing system of claim 1, wherein to determine whether the obtained vacuum pressure measurement satisfies the vacuum pressure criterion, the controller is to:
determine whether the obtained vacuum pressure measurement exceeds a vacuum pressure measurement threshold,
wherein the obtained vacuum pressure measurement is determined to satisfy the vacuum pressure criterion responsive to the obtained vacuum pressure measurement exceeding the vacuum pressure measurement threshold.
8. The manufacturing system of claim 1, wherein the controller is to detect the presence of the object placed based on one or more readings by a presence sensor of the end effector, wherein the presence sensor comprises at least one of a thru-beam sensor, an optical sensor, a reflective sensor, a capacitance sensor, a Halifax sensor, an ultrasonic sensor, or a weight-based sensor.
9. The manufacturing system of claim 1, wherein the object comprises at least one of a substrate, a process kit ring, a process kit ring carrier, a diagnostic wafer, or a cover wafer.

18. A robot arm for a manufacturing system, comprising:
